summary: Verified the impersonation-navigation bug fix end-to-end via UI (frontend only). All impersonation entry points now correctly navigate to the role-specific portal (not '/', not admin) and set the impersonation Bearer + show the ImpersonationBanner with Exit. Admin regression works.

test_results.impersonate_driver_from_users: PASS - AdminPanel Users → open-portal-btn-82b3489b-6268-42c5-be1c-c5af4b819edd (Tracy Fortune) → navigated to /driver-dashboard. Banner shows 'Editing as Tracy Fortune (driver) — admin (changes are live)' with Exit control.
test_results.exit_impersonation: PASS - Exit button returned to /admin (own admin session); banner disappears.
test_results.impersonate_merchant_from_approvals: PASS - Approvals → click 'Merchant/Vendor Applications' sub-tab THEN 'All Records' status filter (order matters: switching category resets status to pending in AdminApprovals.js:421). record-portal-bpapp_10c9e7a0 (BulkProv Store, business) → navigated to /vendor-dashboard. Banner: 'Editing as BulkProv Store (business) — admin (changes are live)'. Exit works. Confirmed this path now switches (previously did not on web).
test_results.impersonate_from_account_repair: PASS - Approvals → Account Repair tool (data-testid=account-repair-tool) → search 'Tracy' → account-repair-viewas-0 → navigated to /dashboard (Tracy Fortune shown here as customer, so /dashboard is correct per portalPathForRole). Banner 'Editing as Tracy Fortune (customer) — admin (changes are live)' + Exit.
test_results.admin_regression: PASS - After multiple impersonate + exit cycles, /admin still loads the admin dashboard normally.
test_results.applicants_entry_point: NOT DRIVEN IN UI - AdminApplicants.viewPortal uses identical startImpersonation + navigate(portalPathForRole(target.user_type)) pattern as AdminApprovals (which was verified). Code parity confirmed by inspection.

notable_observations: In Approvals, clicking a category sub-tab (Driver Applications / Merchant/Vendor Applications / Live Restaurants / …) triggers setStatusFilter(defaultStatusFor(c.key)) (AdminApprovals.js:421) which resets the New/All toggle back to 'pending'. So to reach the merchant record-portal buttons you must click the sub-tab FIRST and THEN switch to 'All Records'. Not a bug for this fix, but a UX gotcha for future tests.
Impersonation banner is rendered via ImpersonationBanner.js and its Exit button is a plain <button> with text 'Exit'; a data-testid would make it more robust to target.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.impersonate stores the impersonation JWT into localStorage.token, overwriting the sentinel used by the web cookie-session. On Exit it should restore the sentinel (or clear) — appears handled, but worth a targeted test to ensure the admin's httpOnly cookie is still relied on and no stale Bearer leaks into subsequent admin requests.
Consider adding data-testid='impersonation-banner' and data-testid='impersonation-exit-btn' to ImpersonationBanner for testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Approvals: click Merchant/Vendor sub-tab THEN [data-testid=approvals-status-all] to reveal record-portal buttons. Admin login via /login form works (httpOnly cookie). ImpersonationBanner has no data-testid; target via text 'Editing as' and button:has-text('Exit').
